verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch ships Embed, which creates a mini runnable version of Hoppscotch on an HTML page so an audience can interact with an API request. That gives runnable examples, but not a full interactive API reference. Probes found no published OpenAPI spec for Hoppscotch's own API, and a community user notes you can't create documentation for a folder or request. missing for 10: a browsable interactive API reference (own or generated), an OpenAPI/spec-backed docs page, documentation authoring for collections, independent corroboration of Embed in use.
